quest.title: Pirate Invasion, in Liyue Harbor!
quest.description: There's a group of kids who are very eager to play a pirate-themed game...

talks.objective: Talk to Little Lulu, Little Fei, and Little Meng

dialogues.speaker: Little Meng
dialogues.text: Lulu, how come I'm the captain again?

dialogues.speaker: Little Lulu
dialogues.text: Because it's way more fun when you're the captain.

dialogues.speaker: Little Fei
dialogues.text: Well, as long as Lulu's happy... then I'm fine with it.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What are you doing?

dialogues.speaker: Little Lulu
dialogues.text: We're playing a game!

dialogues.speaker: Little Lulu
dialogues.text: Meng is the captain, Fei is first mate and I'm a rich merchant.

dialogues.speaker: Little Lulu
dialogues.text: All we're missing is the pirate. The pirate's supposed to come and rob us.

dialogues.speaker: Little Lulu
dialogues.text: You can be the pirate if you wanna play with us?

response.speaker: Little Lulu
response.text: Okay, come and let us know when you're ready.

choices.text: I wanna be one of the good guys...

response.speaker: Little Lulu
response.text: It's just a game! Don't worry, I know you're a good person in real life.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm ready.

dialogues.speaker: Little Lulu
dialogues.text: Woohoo! We're starting!

dialogues.speaker: Little Lulu
dialogues.text: You have to start.

dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: Avast ye! I be here to rob yer!

dialogues.speaker: Little Meng
dialogues.text: Hah! In broad daylight? Good luck, the Millelith men are right there watching!

dialogues.speaker: Little Fei
dialogues.text: Lulu, come quickly! We must escape...

dialogues.speaker: Little Lulu
dialogues.text: Hello Mr. Pirate. What are you here to rob?

dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: Er... Mora? ...Ar!

dialogues.speaker: Little Lulu
dialogues.text: But I don't have much Mora...

dialogues.speaker: Little Lulu
dialogues.text: Daddy says that on a boat, the most valuable thing is the merchants' goods.

dialogues.speaker: Little Lulu
dialogues.text: How about this. Why don't you go and find some valuable things to use in the game?

dialogues.speaker: Little Lulu
dialogues.text: Then we'll have goods for you to try and steal!

dialogues.speaker: Little Lulu
dialogues.text: Hmm... Lotus Heads will do.

dialogues.speaker: Little Lulu
dialogues.text: We three all love eating Lotus Heads. If you're being a naughty pirate, the naughtiest thing you could do is steal our favorite food!

dialogues.speaker: Little Lulu
dialogues.text: Have you found the Lotus Heads yet?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Got them.

dialogues.speaker: Little Lulu
dialogues.text: Yay!

dialogues.speaker: Little Lulu
dialogues.text: Meng! Fei! Come and eat these Lotus Heads with me!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey! Paimon thought we were supposed to be robbing you?

dialogues.speaker: Little Lulu
dialogues.text: Oh, yeah... Well here you are, take this Mora and stuff.

dialogues.speaker: Little Lulu
dialogues.text: You're really great at playing a pirate. Not everyone has what it takes to steal all this stuff from a little kid.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon has a feeling that this kid is subtly mocking us...

dialogues.speaker: Little Lulu
dialogues.text: Thanks for your help and it was fun playing with you. Please play with us again soon!

dialogues.speaker: Little Lulu
dialogues.text: Ready?

dialogues.speaker: Little Lulu
dialogues.text: Found the Lotus Heads?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Not yet.

dialogues.speaker: Little Lulu
dialogues.text: Okay, just keep looking. Take your time... but hopefully not too much time.

dialogues.speaker: Little Lulu
dialogues.text: We've been playing for ages, I'm getting hungry now...
